architecture.reason: The frozen diagnosis identifies objective/identity/temporal-decoding failures but does not establish an architecture-capacity bottleneck.

objective.base: per-string categorical cross-entropy over 20 fret classes plus silence, ignoring MASK

contentWeighting.method: bounded inverse-square-root weighting from training performance-group counts
contentWeighting.purpose: prevent sparse primary classes from receiving vanishing supervision without changing epoch performance exposure

continuityRegularizer.scope: adjacent valid frames whose reference state is unchanged
continuityRegularizer.measure: mean squared difference between adjacent class-probability vectors
continuityRegularizer.purpose: penalize unstable within-run probability swings without smoothing across true reference state boundaries

exactStringPitchEquivalentMargin.purpose: force the correct string/fret probability above alternative playable string/fret positions representing the same pitch

decoder.type: confidence hysteresis plus bounded same-fret gap merge and singleton suppression
intent: bridge <=40 ms confidence dips inside otherwise stable same-fret runs
reduce event fragmentation without changing reference acceptance thresholds

syntheticVerificationRequirements: bounded content balancing gives sparse classes nonzero stronger supervision while remaining within frozen caps
missed active frames receive stronger loss than under unweighted V2-style supervision
pitch-equivalent wrong-string alternatives receive a positive margin penalty
stable reference runs penalize fragmenting probability swings
decoder merges a <=2-frame same-fret gap and removes a one-frame false event while preserving the true onset
V3 objective produces finite gradients on exact pinned TabCNN runtime
uninterrupted and serialized-resumed TabCNN synthetic optimization are bit-exact for model, optimizer and Python/NumPy/Torch RNG state
